assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production website hero illustration for MiroFish, a local research and social simulation studio.
Primary request: A premium editorial sculptural illustration expressing documents becoming a connected network of different perspectives, then a clear insight. One compact still-life: three gently fanned paper cards entering a delicate constellation of 7 rounded connected navy and pale blue nodes, with two small speech-bubble forms among them and one warm terracotta orange focal node. The graph gently arcs upward from the cards. Evocative of a small architectural model on a designer's desk.
Style/medium: refined matte ceramic and folded paper, restrained three-dimensional editorial design, crisp elegant silhouettes, subtle paper grain, no toy-like gloss.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 3:2, complete objects with ample transparent padding, compact centered composition with low horizontal footprint; intended display is about 380 by 230 CSS pixels beside a heading. Orthographic three-quarter view. Simplify small details to stay legible at that scale.
Lighting/mood: soft warm studio lighting, subtle contact shadows attached only to objects, thoughtful, calm, practical, approachable.
Color palette: warm ivory #f7f6f2 and #e9e5db, deep navy #203449, muted powder blue #a7bbcc, restrained burnt orange #b84d28.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha, not an opaque color, no ground plane or horizon. Should sit gracefully on both warm offwhite and dark navy UI.
Text: none.
Constraints: no text, lettering, numbers, logos, watermark, arrows with labels, borders, dashboard UI, people, floating glitter, excessive blobs, gradients in background, sci-fi neon, or photorealistic screens. This is an illustration asset, not a screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production empty-history illustration for MiroFish research workspace.
Primary request: A quiet, inviting paper-and-ceramic still life showing the beginning of an exploration: a small shallow deep-navy document tray holding three blank warm-ivory paper sheets, with one small terracotta orange sphere and one pale powder-blue sphere joined by a short slender ivory connector beside the tray. Two nodes symbolize the first connection made from a document.
Style/medium: premium editorial 3D illustration, matte tactile ceramic and folded paper, refined architectural-model craftsmanship, subtle paper grain, clean restrained silhouettes, same family as cream/navy/orange research studio artwork.
Composition/framing: isolated compact centered composition, wide 3:2 canvas, orthographic three-quarter view, ample fully transparent breathing space around all edges. Designed to remain clear at 180 by 120 CSS pixels. Only the tray, sheets and two connected nodes.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral studio light, subtle contact shadows attached only to the objects, calm and inviting.
Color palette: ivory #f7f6f2 and #e9e5db, deep navy #203449, powder blue #a7bbcc, restrained warm orange #b84d28.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha, no horizon, no background plane, no glow or dark halo; suitable for both offwhite and dark navy UI backgrounds.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, writing, text, logos, watermark, humans, plants, sparkles, UI frames, oversized object pile, gradients, neon, glossy plastic, checkerboard pattern, or opaque background.

processing: Original PNGs preserved. Web delivery copies resized and encoded to WebP with alpha preserved; no compositional edits.
